identitySemantics.actorId: Exact curated participant id. Must equal CUTSCENE_SCRIPT_V1 cast[].id and dialogue speaker/listener values.
identitySemantics.identityHandle: Stable logical Emotional Dialogue identity published by Unity. Not Actor Catalog identity and not Ui/portrait identity.
identitySemantics.presentation: FullPortrait presentation comes from the same curated CharacterPack and never creates identity.

preJsonGate: If the request contains dialogue, load the verified atomic Emotional Dialogue repertoire before generating JSON.
If the repertoire is missing, stale, non-atomic, unverified or has zero authoringReady characters, stop before JSON and state that dialogue authoring is disabled.
If the user requests a character absent from the authoringReady repertoire, stop before JSON, state that the character is unavailable for dialogue and list only the available repertoire.
Never silently substitute a different dialogue character.
lineRules: speaker and listener are exact actorId values and must have exact matching cast[].id entries.
The matching cast entry identityHandle must equal the character identityHandle published by the repertoire.
If expressionIntent is omitted, Unity uses the published defaultExpression.
If expressionIntent is present, it must exactly match one supportedExpressions value for that speaker.
Unsupported expressions are blockers. There is no Neutral fallback and no portrait search.
Listener presentation uses the listener's published defaultExpression unless future CURRENT contract explicitly exposes listener expression authoring.
